title: More control in the Enter dashboard
summary:
A dashboard-focused day: tighter API-key and model controls, cleaner infrastructure, and metrics that now count the right things.

Enter gained an API-key management dialog with enable controls and budgets, plus category-level select-all toggles for model permissions. The dashboard UI was also reorganized and its Linux import casing fixed, because files can apparently have opinions about capitalization.

Azure configuration was cleaned up: Midijourney now points to GPT-5.2, while GPT Image moved to East US 2. Mostly plumbing, but useful plumbing is what keeps the pixels arriving.

The D7 activation-rate calculation was corrected, and the February 4 Instagram post was prepared. Better numbers, plus the regular proof that the garden is still alive.
